    Complete orthogonal projection families #

    A complete orthogonal projection family is a complete family of orthogonal idempotents whose members are self-adjoint. For endomorphisms of a Hilbert space, these families describe orthogonal decompositions of the identity.

    The matched overlap ∑ i, Q i * P i has algebraic block formulas requiring only orthogonal idempotents. These formulas support simultaneous intertwining of projection families, without requiring the spectral or polar-decomposition API here.

    source
    structure LargeIndecomposable.Foundations.IsCompleteOrthogonalProjectionFamily {R : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [Semiring R] [Fintype ι] [Star R] (P : ι → R) extends CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents P :
    Prop

    A finite family of self-adjoint orthogonal idempotents with sum equal to the identity. For Hilbert-space endomorphisms, its members are orthogonal projections.

    • idem (i : ι) : IsIdempotentElem (P i)
    • ortho : Pairwise fun (x1 x2 : ι) => P x1 * P x2 = 0
    • complete : ∑ i : ι, P i = 1
    • isSelfAdjoint (i : ι) : IsSelfAdjoint (P i)

      Each member is self-adjoint.
